title: Character Reference Scene
description: A consistency-focused scene using named character, location, and prop references.

source.note: YAPPY-owned rewrite of timing, reference, and A/B workflow concepts; no source code or proprietary provider client imported.

defaults.shot_plan: one establishing shot followed by a motivated close-up

template:
Generate a consistency test scene. {{character_reference_instruction}} {{location_reference_instruction}} {{prop_reference_instruction}}

The character performs {{character_action}} in {{setting}}. Camera: {{camera_setup}}. Lighting: {{lighting}}. Expression: {{expression}}. Wardrobe must remain {{wardrobe}}.

TIMELINE:
00:00–00:01 — silent identity-confirming pose with face and wardrobe readable.
00:01–{{speech_end}} — exact dialogue: "{{dialogue}}" while completing the action without occluding identity anchors.
{{closing_start}}–{{duration_timestamp}} — silent profile or three-quarter hold for continuity review.

Do not alter age presentation, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, distinguishing features, wardrobe colors, location anchors, or prop geometry. Maintain natural anatomy and stable hands. {{audio_reference_instruction}}
